name: BVG when work stops at 50: transfer to vested benefits
workings: Born 1976-05-01; retirement assets 500,000.00; conversion rate 5.4% at 65, 0.2 points less for each year earlier, more for each later; real interest 0%; Swiss inflation 1%.
Work stopped at 50, before 58: the assets move untaxed to a vested-benefits account, whatever route the plan names.
